title: Stored x-only leaf birthday search on secp256k1 at 124.553210294878063: 38df975c plus the changes of proof.md section 9

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.390000001 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins (Chen-Stein on cross-node leaf pairs; drops, caps, wrong class indices, label errors, the carry sites of section 3.4 and the fixup meter's cap are charged failure rows; success.md). Its expected total work is at most 2^124.553210294878063 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit; at most 225.8939 per leaf), E-averaged over 114 X-groups that stop at the first resolving group, with every walk, key path and defect row charged by history-conditional domination (success.md 6.6); the worst case on every run, 2^188.604975 instructions, is disclosed. Six leaves x(phi^t(X) +- Y) per batched inverse of y_Y^2 - y_X^2 are labelled by 128-bit truncated fraction products of their Fourier components (sections 3.1-3.3; bwd 1230.25 and keys 132.5 instructions per pair); records travel two hops in 256-record blocks and join by hash chains at hop-2 arrival (sections 2, 4); every delivery is charged as executed code, with FEAT_LS64 64-byte LD64B/ST64B moving two records at a time between the link window (Device) and R2 (Normal Non-cacheable). Peak memory at most 2^135.9990 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^117.0744 units, included; no advice; certificate.py checks every declared figure. kaankolcu 38df975c (124.645118129451422, declared dependency) plus the changes listed in proof.md section 9 (DC ZVA head zeroing from kaankolcu 8c3852be and the four-body bwd loop from aburan28 c3e0530e, declared); credits: proof.md 9; no prior acceptance or score is a premise. An analytic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Leaf kernels on production points against bit-exact models of bwd and keys (fractions, bounds, Fourier identity, records, indices, labels); class tests; both hops and the join on a 4 x 4 machine (machine.py, grouped_paths); the 3.4 sites and fixups (sites.py); every kernel count against certificate.py, which it runs. Budget-limited parts run stated minimums. Not a production-scale attack.
